name: Insurance-Premium-Prediction-API-Serving-System
description: An end-to-end Machine Learning application that predicts insurance premium categories based on customer demographics, lifestyle factors, health indicators, and financial information.

paragraphs: HealthSure InsurTech is a comprehensive healthcare data intelligence and actuarial risk platform. It unites machine learning actuarial underwriting, dynamic batch file ingestion (CSV/Excel), Google Gemini LLM executive risk intelligence, and longitudinal Electronic Health Records (EHR) analytics into an intuitive multi-module system.
The platform enables insurers, actuaries, and evaluators to:
features: Underwrite Single Applicants: Predict risk-adjusted insurance premium tiers (Low, Medium, High) with real-time biometric readouts ($BMI$, $HRI$) and automated Google Gemini actuarial briefs.

Batch Underwrite Entire Portfolios: Upload custom .csv or .xlsx policyholder files, trigger high-throughput asynchronous machine learning scoring with live progress bars, and dynamically render interactive Plotly…

Analyze Clinical Comorbidity Burden: Compute Charlson Comorbidity Index (CCI) scores, calculate associative disease lift ($P(A \cap B) / [P(A) \times P(B)]$), and analyze length of stay vs. inpatient cost.
Compare Patient Cohorts: Define dual clinical cohorts with multi-variable filters and run automated statistical hypothesis tests (Welch's t-test and Pearson's Chi-square via scipy.stats).
Audit Longitudinal Records (Patient 360): Deep-dive into high-risk applicants with multi-year diagnoses, lab trends, and 1-click clinical PDF export.
